notes.title: Demo v1.29.6
notes.content:
Greetings! Thank you for playing the demo! I hope you're enjoying it so far (and if you are, please consider adding the game to your wishlist and dropping a review for the demo ❤️)

Anyhoo, I've been working to patch out some issues. Here's a quick rundown!

[list]
[*] Fixed leaderboard score retrieval range for affected players
[*] Penguin now pulses to the beat in the gameover screen's leaderboard
[*] Added support for screenshot taking in-game (Press F12)
[*] Minor UI fixes
[*] CRT toggle now works properly
[*] Minimum window size implemented
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537305/e5df2840a100aea1c5d5d5a351a20d275cf94926.jpg[/img]
[i]Thank you for playing, you absolute legends![/i]
